verdict.rationale: Eqvista is a cap-table and equity-management SaaS, so user-defined recurring jobs or workflows are a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no scheduler, recurring automation, or workflow engine. Vesting schedules are an equity-terms feature and annual corporate filings are a service add-on; neither lets a user schedule recurring jobs, so both are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
